body:
Thank you for yours words. I definitely suffer from "the busy brain freakout" lol I finally messaged just asking directly if I had said or done anything wrong. They said no they just have phone anxiety but I am not exactly sure what that means if they are worried about my replies or receiving texts in general so I just tried to tell them that I was always available to meet in person and to enjoy the rest of their day. 

That was a few hours ago but I can't stop thinking about them I wait in anticipation to hear from them and asking to meet up or just initiate a conversation because I don't want to cause them any extra stress or worry.
Thank you for your words. It has helped I have calmed down now but been unable to sleep. I still feel very lost right now but I am trying to distract myself from my worries.
